protocol.threshold: Per category and reference seed; empirical higher quantile of 100 normal calibration scores
protocol.test_set: Same previously examined 802 images; descriptive operating-point analysis, not an independent test
protocol.repetition: Five reference selections reuse the same test images; SD measures reference-selection variability only
protocol.quantile_discreteness: With 100 calibration normals and strict >, nominal 1/5/10% targets are discrete and do not guarantee future test FPR
protocol.miss_review: Persistent means missed or alarmed in all five reference selections at that configuration/threshold; the five decisions are not an ensemble
